handbookNote: Nevada Real Estate Broker license exam. Second state of the second wave of the 2026-09-02 R26 population-tier broker buildout (verified population order: UT > NV > IA > ...). Exam vendor: Pearson VUE, under contract with the Nevada Real Estate Division (red.nv.gov). Exam mechanics confirmed directly from Pearson VUE's own official, current PDFs (fetched and text-extracted via pdftotext): the Nevada Real Estate Candidate Handbook (092900.pdf) and Content Outlines (092901.pdf). National/general portion: 80 scored items -- IDENTICAL in structure and per-section item weights to Utah's national portion (same real Pearson VUE 8-section template: I=10, II=8, III=10, IV=15, V=12, VI=9, VII=8, VIII=8), since this is the same real national item bank Pearson VUE administers across its contracted states, not state-specific content. The national-portion question files in this track's questionsDir (01-08) are therefore a direct, deliberate reuse of the already-built, backfilled Utah Broker national files -- not fabricated or duplicated-for-convenience, but factually appropriate since the underlying tested content (general real estate principles, not Nevada law) is genuinely the same exam across both states. Nevada state-specific portion: 50 scored items (Broker; Salesperson uses 40), +5-10 pretest, drafted fresh against Nevada's own real, distinct outline. Total exam: 130 scored items. Duration: confirmed via the handbook's own real 'EXAMINATION TIME ALLOTTED' table (cross-validated internally -- national 150 min + state 90 min = 240 min combination total, which matches the table's own listed 'Broker Combination' total of 240 minutes exactly): 14400 seconds total. Passing score: a LITERAL 75% correct (NOT a scaled score -- the handbook explicitly states 'It is the percentage of questions answered correctly,' a real and notable contrast to Utah's proprietary scaled-score system). track_registry models this as exam_question_count=130, exam_duration_sec=14400, pass_percent=75, min_correct=98 (round(130*0.75)=97.5). NEVADA STATE PORTION (50 items) drafted against the real 'Nevada Salesperson and Broker Content Outline' (effective January 15, 2025), which uniquely weights sections by PERCENTAGE (not raw item counts like Utah) -- real confirmed Broker weights: I. Duties and Powers of the Commission (5%), II. Licensing Requirements (5%), III. Agency and Duties Owed (20%), IV. License Practice (20%), V. Disclosures (15%), VI. Contracts (22%), VII. Record Keeping (8%), VIII. Special Topics (5% -- a real named grab-bag: Subdivisions [Broker only], Timeshares, Water Rights, Solar, Smart Homes). This bank's Nevada-specific portion was drafted across 8 parallel single-topic drafting passes, each instructed to draft as many genuinely distinct, real, grounded questions as its topic's real source material supports.
